local_modifications.reason: Captured WordPress/Elementor output addresses its own assets at the absolute source origin. Every target is already present locally and resolvable through route_map.
local_modifications.change: Replaced the literal source-origin prefix (plain, escaped-JSON and protocol-relative forms) with a root-relative path in captured text assets. No copy, markup, layout, media selection or behaviour was altered.
local_modifications.validation_evidence: Re-run viewports.py over the declared route x viewport matrix and confirm no request targets the source origin.
